# @neon/env

> 标签: database, dotenv, env, neon, platform, postgres

## 简介

Resolve and inject Neon connection strings for the branch selected by your neon.ts policy. fetchEnv / parseEnv plus a `neon-env` CLI with `run` and `export`.
